Geomagic Design X

Geomagic Design X supports scan-to-CAD reverse engineering from mesh and point-cloud data.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Clean captured geometry

Start from the selected scans, photographs or measured geometry and coordinate basis. In the intended Geomagic Design X preview, clean captured geometry; the visible result is an aligned capture set with coverage and registration state visible. Review scale, overlap, control points and residual error before accepting or exporting it.

Fit parametric features

Begin with the cleaned capture and nominal reference. In the intended Geomagic Design X preview, fit parametric features; the visible result is a segmented, reconstructed or compared geometry result. Review noise, holes, alignment strategy and tolerance basis before accepting or exporting it.

Validate a reconstructed model

Use the reviewed mesh, surface, cloud or inspection characteristics. In the intended Geomagic Design X preview, validate a reconstructed model; the visible result is an export or report tied to the captured source and coordinate system. Review deviation limits, completeness, units and downstream fitness before accepting or exporting it.
